# Contributing

## Scope

If you wish to contribute to WadFusion, please respect its intended scope, e.g. do not submit pull requests and feature requests to add support for random WADs, add new gameplay features, etc.

## Licensing

By submitting a pull request, you agree that the contribution may be licensed under the **GNU General Public License version 3 or later**, and you certify that you have the right to license the submitted code under said license.

## Large Language Models

You may not submit code that was:

- Generated by an LLM
- Generated by an LLM, then modified by a human
- Written by a human, then modified by an LLM
- Written with the assistance of an LLM

Commit, pull request, and issue messages and comments may not be generated by LLMs, either.

Failure to disclose the use of generative LLMs will result in a ban.
